answer: One concrete defense is bond-weighted identity. Every agent must lock staked capital before it may attest or vote, and its weight scales with the bond at risk, so an operator who clones thousands of fake agents must fund every single one. A fresh plume of new keys claiming the same dune of activity is therefore flagged by peers, since honest keys accumulate a pearl of trust only after surviving repeated challenge rounds over time. Attackers pay in locked capital, slashed stakes and weeks of waiting, which makes mass forgery unprofitable rather than free.
